intent: Implement the user-approved tightening corrections for rules 3, 4, 5 and 7. Keep historical replay and canonical Evidence/Reality/Judgment/Outcome fail-closed, while making the current research workspace include current research-only analysis by default; distinguish archive coverage gaps from world-state unknowns; degrade non-truth researcher enrichments instead of failing the whole view; and replace the one-selected-assertion membership projection shortcut with a model-mediated semantic decision that escalates material-definition conflicts to deep reasoning before catalog materialization. Persist the model decision as audit provenance and never treat the model decision itself as source Evidence or canonical Reality.
rationale: The user accepted the strict-truth/useful-analysis split and explicitly requested four follow-on changes. Current research belongs by default in the current research workspace but not historical replay. Archive absence must be rendered as research coverage state rather than silently becoming a world-state claim. Optional read-model enrichment should degrade with diagnostics while truth-bearing phases remain fail-closed. Industry membership projection must no longer confuse physical assertion cardinality with semantic certainty: a model semantic judge evaluates the selected assertion set, automatically escalates conflicting material definitions to deep reasoning, persists an audit-only decision, and only then materializes the existing catalog projection. CAP-0003 remains owner of accepted source-backed assertions; the decision row is projection provenance, not a new truth owner.
